label: Google Sheets: Update Row
description: Overwrite one row, addressed by its sheet row number (from Append Row, Lookup, or the New Row trigger) or by an explicit A1 range. Pass an object keyed by header column names or a plain list of cells.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: A Google account with write access to the sheet (the picker grant covers the file it picked).

inputs.name: spreadsheet
inputs.label: Spreadsheet
inputs.placeholder: Pick one, or paste its share link

inputs.name: tab
inputs.label: Tab
inputs.placeholder: Pick a tab, or paste a link with #gid=

inputs.name: row
inputs.description: The replacement row: an object keyed by header column names, or a plain list of cells in order.

inputs.name: rowNumber
inputs.label: Row number
inputs.description: The 1-based sheet row to overwrite (exactly one of rowNumber / range).

inputs.name: range
inputs.label: Range
inputs.description: An A1 range inside the tab to write instead of a whole row (exactly one of rowNumber / range).

inputs.name: hasHeader
inputs.label: First row is a header
inputs.description: Needed to order an object row's columns.
